top_signals.title: Oil Prices Drop for Third Week Straight
top_signals.summary: Oil prices fell on Friday and were set for a weekly decline on strong exports from the Middle East despite Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh and reports of tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.Brent crude futures were down 67 cents, or 0.7%, at $91.31 a barrel at 1414 GMT.

top_signals.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
top_signals.summary: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found the company was simply paying the attackers for a decryption key and charging victims a markup for work that was never performed.

top_signals.summary: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Expands Oil Storage in Japan as Tokyo Restocks
top_signals.summary: Japan plans to buy up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude for the national petroleum reserve it drew down during the Hormuz crisis, under a deal the two countries announced on Friday that makes the purchases subject to favorable market conditions. The deal also gives Saudi Arabia temporary use of an additional 16 million barrels of storage capacity in Japan, expanding the 8 million barrels it already holds there, and the kingdom has begun refilling those tanks, Bloomberg reported.
